title: Most news apps are designed to make you scroll faster, not think deeper.
body:
We built Deep Dive Mode at Headlinne for a simple reason. We noticed that reading a headline or a quick summary often leaves you with more questions than answers. You get the 'what' but you miss the 'why' and the 'how' that actually matters.

Deep Dive Mode changes the relationship between reader and story. Instead of just giving you the latest update, it connects the dots to previous events, explains complex terms in plain language, and provides the context you need to form your own opinion. It is not about adding more noise to your feed. It is about distilling the signal.

We believe technology should work for your curiosity, not against your attention span. Understanding a story should feel like having a conversation with an editor who actually knows what they are talking about.
cta: If you want to see how we are rethinking the way we consume information, take a look at HEADLINNE.com.
